items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A vertically stacked set of headings that each reveal a section of content. Use it for FAQs and other long lists where readers only need a few sections at a time; it opens one section at once by default, or several with the multiple prop.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A short banner that shows a message tied to the page around it, with an optional icon, a title, a description and one follow-up action. Use it for inline notices and errors that should stay visible, not for transient confirmations; it has a default and a destructive variant.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal that blocks outside dismissal until the user picks one of its own actions. Use it to confirm a choice that cannot be undone, such as deleting data; for ordinary focused tasks, use a dialog.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: A container that reserves space at a fixed ratio before media loads. Wrap an image, video or embed in it with a numeric ratio such as 16 / 9 so the page does not jump when the media arrives.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A round or square photo that stands for a person, with initials or an icon when the photo is missing, plus status, verified, count and company badges. Use it wherever someone appears; it also ships a group stack, an add button, a name-and-subtitle label group and a large profile photo.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small pill that labels a status, a count or a category next to other content, such as paid, pending or overdue. Choose it for short read-only labels, and use the dot, image, count and remove parts to add detail; it comes in three shapes, three sizes and six variants.

items.name: badge-group
items.title: Badge Group
items.description: A tag paired with a short message beside it, for an announcement or update that needs more than a status word. Use it as a link at the top of a page or section; it has a light and a modern theme, two sizes, and can lead or trail with the tag.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A trail of links showing where the current page sits in the hierarchy, with the current page shown as plain text. Use it on pages nested two or more levels deep; a row of dots can stand in for crumbs that do not fit.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A button with ten variants, five sizes, five icon-only sizes and a loading state that keeps its width.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for picking one date, a range or a date decades back, with days disabled by rule. Use it for booking, scheduling and date-of-birth fields, on its own or inside a popover.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A bordered surface that groups related content, built from optional header, title, description, action, content and footer parts. Reach for it to frame a self-contained block such as an invoice, a settings panel or a dashboard figure; it comes in a default and a compact size.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A box for one yes-or-no value in a form, with a third mixed state for a group that is only partly ticked. Use it for independent options, consent and select-all lists.

items.name: close-button
items.title: Close Button
items.description: An icon-only button that shows an X, in four sizes and a light or dark theme. Use it to dismiss a banner, panel or any surface that has no built-in close control.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A single section that expands and collapses on its own, with no sibling sections to coordinate. Use it to hide secondary content behind one trigger; use an accordion when several sections should open and close together.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A searchable, keyboard-navigable list of commands, with groups, shortcuts and an optional dialog wrapper. Use it to build a command palette or quick-action menu where users type to filter and press Enter to run.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window for a focused task, closed by its own close button, an outside click or escape. Use it for forms and detail views; for a decision that must not be dismissed by accident, use an alert dialog.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: A provider that sets left-to-right or right-to-left behaviour for every Base UI component beneath it, plus a hook that reads the current direction. Wrap a right-to-left page in it, together with a dir attribute, so sliders, tabs and keyboard navigation follow the reading direction.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A touch-first panel that slides in from any edge and is dismissed by dragging it away, with optional snap points and a swipe handle. Use it for mobile-style sheets and bottom panels; for a side panel with no drag, use a sheet.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: A centered icon, title and description for a list, search or panel that has nothing in it yet. Use it when a view is empty on purpose or because a search matched nothing, and add a button underneath when there is a next step.

items.name: featured-icon
items.title: Featured Icon
items.description: A small icon frame in six fills and five colors, for notices, empty states and list headers. Use it to give an icon more presence than a bare glyph, in a size from 32 to 56 pixels.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A read-only preview card that opens on hover or keyboard focus of a link, so people can see what it points to without navigating. Use it for static previews such as a profile or page summary; use a popover when the content needs interaction.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single line text field that keeps the browser's native input types and adds three sizes and invalid, disabled and read-only states. Use it for names, emails, passwords, search and dates.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A row of single character boxes, backed by one hidden input, for typing or pasting a verification code. Use it for one-time passcodes, with six sizes and optional groups split by a separator.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Shows a keyboard key or a whole shortcut inline, in the monospace face. Use Kbd for a single key and KbdGroup to keep a shortcut such as Command K together.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The name for a form control, with an optional required marker that picks up invalid and disabled states from its props or from a wrapper. Pair one with every input, checkbox, radio and switch.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page by page navigation with previous and next links, numbered pages, an active page indicator and an ellipsis for long runs. Use it under a list or table that is split across pages; the links render as anchors.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A click-triggered popup anchored to its trigger that can hold interactive content such as inputs and buttons. Use it for a small form or settings panel; for text-only hints, reach for a tooltip or hover card.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A bar or ring that fills to show how far a task has got, or pulses when there is nothing to measure yet. Use the bar for uploads and multi-step flows and the circle or half circle for a figure on a dashboard; a value of null shows the indeterminate state.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A set of options where choosing one releases the rest, so the group always holds a single answer. Use it when people must pick exactly one of a few visible choices.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: A row of stars that fills to a fractional value, plus a compact rating badge with laurel wreaths for social proof. Use the stars to show a score such as 4.8 out of 5 on a product or review, and the badge for award-style marks.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Draggable panels that sit side by side or stacked, with an optional grip on the divider and panels that collapse when dragged below their minimum. Use it for split views such as a list beside a detail pane or an editor above its output.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scrollable container with slim custom scrollbars in place of the browser's own. Use it to cap the height or width of a long list, log or row of cards; add a horizontal scrollbar when the content can overflow sideways.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A one-pixel rule that divides content horizontally or vertically. Reach for it to split a heading from what follows or to separate items in a row.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A side panel that slides in from any edge for forms and settings, opened and closed by clicking, with no drag gesture. Use it for longer editing tasks that should keep the page visible; for a touch-first panel dismissed by dragging, use a drawer.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder shaped like the content it stands in for while that content loads, with a shimmer sweep by default or a pulse. Size and round it to match the real element so the layout does not jump when the content arrives.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An indeterminate loading indicator in five sizes that takes the surrounding text colour. Use it when work is in progress and you cannot say how long it will take, either inline beside text or centred in an empty panel.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on-off control for a setting that takes effect the moment it is flipped, with no save step behind it. Choose it over a checkbox when the change applies immediately.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows and columns for structured data, with a header, an optional footer, a caption, selectable rows and a compact size. Reach for it when records share the same fields and readers compare them across rows; it scrolls sideways inside its own box when the columns do not fit.

items.name: tags
items.title: Tags
items.description: A removable chip the user attaches themselves, with optional dot, avatar and count. Use it to show applied filters, tagged people or chosen topics; group tags in a tag group to make them selectable, or give one a remove handler.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi line text field that grows with what you type, with three sizes and invalid, disabled and read-only states. Use it for messages, notes and any answer longer than one line.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A single button that stays pressed until something presses it again. Use it for an on or off choice such as bold, favourite or pin, in a default or outline style.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label that appears on hover or keyboard focus of its trigger, with an optional description line and arrow. Use it to name an icon-only control or add a brief hint; it only holds text, so reach for a popover when the content is interactive.

items.name: utility-button
items.title: Utility Button
items.description: A small icon-only button for toolbars and panel headers that carries its label in a tooltip. Use it for quiet actions such as copy, edit or download; it comes as a raised secondary chip or a bare tertiary icon, in two sizes, and shows no tooltip while disabled.
